high_level_description: The image is a stylized black-and-white illustration of a person standing upright. They have one arm bent at the elbow, with the hand resting on their hip, while the other arm is slightly raised, holding what looks like a book or a folder. The person's head is tilted back, and they appear to be looking upwards, possibly towards the sky. The background is plain white, which makes the figure stand out prominently.
